---
title: ergm-quarto edge cases
format: html
---

## No kwargs at all -- must have no `data-ergm-options` attribute

{{< ergm-widget >}}

## Empty model -- must encode as `{"model":[]}`, not `{"model":{}}`

{{< ergm-widget model="" >}}

## A single negative float kwarg

{{< ergm-widget theta-edges=-2.5 >}}

## A bare integer -- must encode as `40`, not `40.0`

{{< ergm-widget n=40 >}}

## Two colours -- proves attribute escaping ran (raw text must contain `&quot;`)

{{< ergm-widget group-colors="#00707a,#c0491f" >}}

## Presentation kwargs: id, class, width, scheme

{{< ergm-widget id="my-widget" class="my-extra-class" width="480px" scheme="dark" >}}

## Boolean coercion variants

{{< ergm-widget auto-start=yes controls-n=false controls-mean-degree=off >}}

## Unknown option -- expected to fail loudly

{{< ergm-widget not-a-real-option=1 >}}

## Unknown model term -- expected to fail loudly

{{< ergm-widget model="edges,bogus" >}}

## Out-of-range soft warning (still renders; check render log for the warning)

{{< ergm-widget n=500 >}}
